He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Pepperdine Waves men's basketball|Pepperdine Waves]]. ==High school career== Ross played four years of [[varsity team|varsity]] basketball for [[Eaglecrest High School]] in [[Centennial, Colorado]]. As a junior, he averaged 18.6 points, 4.6 rebounds and 3.4 assists per game, leading his team to the Class 5A state title game. Ross was named Colorado [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]] and was the only junior selected to play in the state's High School All-Star Game.{{cite web |title=Colbey Ross of Eaglecrest named Gatorade Colorado boys basketball player of the year |url=https://www.denverpost.com/2016/03/17/colbey-ross-of-eaglecrest-named-gatorade-colorado-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year/amp/ |website=[[The Denver Post]] |accessdate=June 16, 2020 |date=March 17, 2016}}{{cite web |last1=Graham |first1=Nick |title=Chauncey Billups HS Hoops: Colbey Ross of Eaglecrest named Gatorade player of the year |url=https://milehighsports.com/chauncey-billups-hs-hoops-colbey-ross-eaglecrest-named-gatorade-player-year/ |publisher=Mile High Sports |accessdate=June 16, 2020 |date=March 17, 2016}} As a senior, he averaged 18.4 points, 5.0 assists, 4.9 rebounds and 2.4 steals per game, helping Eaglecrest win the Class 5A state championship and earning [[most valuable player]] of the state tournament.{{cite web |last1=Casey |first1=Ryan |title=Eaglecrest's Colbey Ross named Gatorade boys basketball player of the year |url=https://chsaanow.com/2017-03-20/eaglecrests-colbey-ross-named-gatorade-boys-basketball-player-year/ |publisher=[[Colorado High School Activities Association]] |accessdate=June 16, 2020 |date=March 20, 2017}} Ross was recognized as [[Mr. Colorado Basketball]] and repeated as Colorado Gatorade Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Newman |first1=Kyle |title=By channeling his emotion, 2017 Mr. Colorado Basketball Colbey Ross exits with championship resume |url=https://www.denverpost.com/2017/03/26/2017-mr-colorado-basketball-colbey-ross-eaglecrest/ |website=[[The Denver Post]] |accessdate=June 16, 2020 |date=March 26, 2017}} He was lightly recruited by [[college basketball]] programs and committed to [[Pepperdine Waves men's basketball|Pepperdine]] over two other [[NCAA Division I]] scholarship offers, from [[Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball|Northern Colorado]] and [[Pacific Tigers men's basketball|Pacific]].{{cite web |last1=Newman |first1=Kyle |title=Amid record-setting college career at Pepperdine, ex-Eaglecrest star Colbey Ross is still flying under the radar |url=https://www.denverpost.com/2020/02/11/ex-eaglecrest-star-colbey-ross-dominant-college-basketball-career-pepperdine/ |website=[[The Denver Post]] |accessdate=June 16, 2020 |date=February 11, 2020}} ==College career== On November 20, 2017, in his fourth college game at Pepperdine, Ross scored a freshman season-high 25 points and added five rebounds and four assists in a 92–84 loss to [[UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball|UC Santa Barbara]] at the [[Legends Classic (basketball tournament)|Legends Classic]].{{cite web |title=Waves Drop Legends Classic Contest to UCSB |url=https://pepperdinewaves.com/news/2017/11/20/Waves_Drop_Legends_Classic_Contest_to_UCSB.aspx |publisher=Pepperdine University Athletics |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=November 20, 2017}} On January 18, 2018, he scored 25 points for a second time, along with eight assists, in a 92–78 loss to [[Pacific Tigers men's basketball|Pacific]].{{cite web |title=Pacific Overcomes Waves' Great Start in Stockton |url=https://pepperdinewaves.com/news/2018/1/18/Pacific_Overcomes_Waves_Great_Start_in_Stockton.aspx |publisher=Pepperdine University Athletics |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=January 18, 2018}} As a freshman, Ross averaged 14 points, 5.6 assists and three rebounds per game, setting a school freshman record for total assists, with 179. He was named to the [[West Coast Conference]] (WCC) All-Freshman Team and was an All-WCC honorable mention selection.{{cite web |last1=Puu |first1=Arthur |title=With Confidence and Clutch Shots, Colbey Ross Gives Men's Basketball a Bright Future |url=https://pepperdine-graphic.com/with-confidence-and-clutch-shots-colbey-ross-gives-mens-basketball-a-bright-future/ |website=Pepperdine Graphic |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=March 20, 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Mauro |first1=Bryan |title=Pepperdine Basketball: In-depth look at Waves Guard Colbey Ross |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2018/07/18/pepperdine-basketball-in-depth-look-at-waves-guard-colbey-ross/ |publisher=Busting Brackets |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=July 18, 2018}} On December 31, 2018, as a sophomore, Ross posted 10 points and a career-high 13 assists in a 100–64 victory over [[Alabama A&M Bulldogs basketball|Alabama A&M]].{{cite web |title=Men's Hoops Blasts Alabama A&M, 100-64 |url=https://pepperdinewaves.com/news/2018/12/31/mens-basketball-mens-hoops-blasts-alabama-am-100-64.aspx |publisher=Pepperdine University Athletics |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=December 31, 2018}} On March 2, 2019, he scored a season-high 36 points and reached 1,000 career points in a 73–72 loss to Pacific.{{cite web |title=Ross Hits Career High in Waves' Loss to Pacific |url=https://pepperdinewaves.com/news/2019/3/2/mens-basketball-ross-hits-career-high-in-waves-loss-to-pacific.aspx |publisher=Pepperdine University Athletics |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=March 2, 2019}} Ross earned WCC All-Tournament Team honors after leading Pepperdine to the semifinals of the [[2019 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|2019 WCC tournament]].{{cite web |last1=Hill |first1=Adam |title=Colbey Ross shoots Pepperdine into WCC tourney quarterfinals |url=https://www.reviewjournal.com/sports/basketball/vegasmadness/colbey-ross-shoots-pepperdine-into-wcc-tourney-quarterfinals-1614299/ |website=[[Las Vegas Review-Journal]] |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=March 8, 2019}} He averaged 19.4 points, a WCC-high seven assists and 2.9 rebounds per game and was named to the first team All-WCC. Ross set single-season program records for total assists and assists per game.{{cite web |title=Colbey Ross |url=https://pepperdinewaves.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/colbey-ross/2903 |publisher=Pepperdine University Athletics |accessdate=June 16, 2020}} On November 19, 2019, as a junior, Ross recorded a then-career-high 38 points and six rebounds in a 91–84 loss to [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]]. On January 4, 2020, he tallied 24 points and 10 assists in a 75–70 loss to second-ranked [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]]. Ross posted 30 points, including 27 in the second half, along with a career-high 14 rebounds and five assists in a 66–59 victory over [[Portland Pilots men's basketball|Portland]] on February 20.{{cite web |title=Pepperdine pulls away late to beat Portland 66-59 |url=https://apnews.com/0de4ebbec9c61f199e62e74e23869c9e |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=February 20, 2020}} In an 89–82 double overtime loss to [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Saint Mary's]] during the [[2020 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|2020 WCC tournament]] quarterfinals, Ross scored a career-high 43 points, making seven three-pointers while adding eight rebounds and five assists. He was named to the WCC All-Tournament Team.{{cite web |title=Ross Scores 43 in 2OT WCC Quarterfinals Defeat |url=https://pepperdinewaves.com/news/2020/3/8/mens-basketball-ross-scores-43-in-2ot-wcc-quarterfinals-defeat.aspx |publisher=Pepperdine University Athletics |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=March 8, 2020}} In his junior season, Ross averaged 20.5 points, a WCC-high 7.2 assists and 4.7 rebounds per game and earned first-team All-WCC honors for his second time. He broke his own school single-season assists record and was the only Division I player to average at least 20 points and seven assists per game. After the season, Ross entered the [[2020 NBA draft]],{{cite web |title=NBA announces early entry candidates for 2020 NBA Draft |url=https://www.nba.com/article/2020/04/28/early-entry-candidates-announced-2020-nba-draft-official-release |publisher=[[National Basketball Association]] |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=April 28, 2020}} before withdrawing from the draft.{{cite web |last1=Oakes |first1=Courtney |title=Pepperdine gets lucky as Colbey Ross decides to go back for senior season |url=https://sentinelcolorado.com/sentinel-blogs/courtney-oakes/oakes-pepperdine-gets-lucky-as-colbey-ross-decides-to-go-back-for-senior-season/ |website=[[Sentinel Colorado]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |date=August 3, 2020}} Coming into his senior season, Ross was named to the Preseason All-WCC team.{{cite web |title=Gonzaga Picked to Win Ninth Straight WCC Championship |url=https://wccsports.com/news/2020/10/25/mens-basketball-gonzaga-picked-to-win-ninth-straight-wcc-championship.aspx |website=[[West Coast Conference]] |accessdate=November 7, 2020 |date=October 26, 2020}} On November 27, 2020, he became Pepperdine's all-time leading scorer while scoring 33 points in a 107–98 triple overtime loss to [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]].{{cite web |last1=Wilson |first1=Bernie |title=Colbey Ross becomes Pepperdine's all-time leading scorer in 3OT loss |url=https://sentinelcolorado.com/sports/college/colbey-ross-becomes-pepperdines-all-time-leading-scorer-in-3ot-loss/ |website=[[Sentinel Colorado]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |date=November 27, 2020}} Ross scored his 2,000th career point in a loss to Gonzaga on January 30, 2021.{{cite news|url= https://pepperdinewaves.com/news/2021/1/30/mens-basketball-ross-scores-2-000th-point-in-loss-to-1-zags.aspx |title= Ross Scores 2,000th Point in Loss to #1 Zags |publisher=[[Pepperdine Waves]]|date= January 30, 2021|access-date=January 31, 2021}} He averaged 17.5 points, 4.1 rebounds, and 7.7 assists per game, leading the Waves to their first [[College Basketball Invitational]] Championship.{{cite web |last1=Magaro-George |first1=Noah |title=Report: The Spurs have conducted a pre-draft workout with Colbey Ross |url=https://www.poundingtherock.com/2021/7/8/22569559/report-the-spurs-have-conducted-a-pre-draft-workout-with-colbey-ross |website=Pounding the Rock |access-date=September 28, 2021 |date=July 8, 2021}} ==Professional career== On September 28, 2021, Ross signed with [[Basketball Nymburk|ERA Nymburk]] of the Czech [[National Basketball League (Czech Republic)|National Basketball League]].{{cite web |last1=Roopnarine |first1=Surujh |title=Colbey Ross agreed terms with Nymburk |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Czech-Republic/news/706628/Colbey-Ross-agreed-terms-with-Nymburk |website=Eurobasket |access-date=September 28, 2021 |date=September 28, 2021}} On July 20, 2022, he has signed with [[Pallacanestro Varese]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/colbey-ross-joins-pallacanestro-varese/|title=Colbey Ross joins Pallacanestro Varese|last=|first=|date=July 20, web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/buducnost-officially-signs-italian-league-mvp-colbey-ross/|title=Buducnost officially signs Italian league mvp Colbey Ross|last=|first=|date=July 23, 2023|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=January 4, 2024}} On December 21, 2023, he signed with [[Derthona Basket]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A|LBA]].{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/derthona-officially-signs-colbey-ross/|title=Derthona officially signs Colbey Ross|last=|first=|date=December 21, 2023|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=January 3, 2024}} On July 5, 2024, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Trieste]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite He later played [[NCAA Division II]] basketball for [[University of Colorado Colorado Springs Mountain Lion Athletics|UCCS]], earning all-conference honors and becoming the program's all-time leader in assists.{{cite web |last1=Whicker |first1=Mark |title=Pepperdine's Colbey Ross and his clever style gives hope |url=https://www.ocregister.com/2019/12/01/whicker-pepperdines-colbey-ross-and-his-clever-style-gives-hope/ |website=[[Orange County Register]] |accessdate=June 29, 2020 |date=December 1, 2019}} Ross' favorite NBA player is [[Damian Lillard]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://pepperdinewaves.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/colbey-ross/2903 Pepperdine Waves bio] {{Pallacanestro Trieste current roster}} {{Lega Basket Serie A MVP}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ross, Colbey}} [[Category:1998 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in the Czech Republic]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball Nymburk players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Arapahoe County, Colorado]] [[Category:Derthona Basket players]] [[Category:KK Budućnost players]] [[Category:Pallacanestro Trieste players]] [[Category:Pallacanestro Varese players]] [[Category:Pepperdine Waves men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Aurora, Colorado]]
